title: Sample Embedding with Epoxy Resin
author: Debora Ferreira Barreto-Vieira
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jqvcmw6

steps.title: Wash Fixed Cells
steps.instruction: Wash previously fixed cells in sodium cacodylate buffer 0.2M in saccharose 7%.

substeps.instruction: Perform the wash for 5 minutes, 3 times.

steps.title: Postfix Cells
steps.instruction: Postfix cells in osmium tetroxide 1% for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Wash Cells
steps.instruction: Wash cells in sodium cacodylate buffer and distilled water.

substeps.instruction: Wash in sodium cacodylate buffer 0.2M in saccharose 7% for 5 minutes (1 time).
Wash in distilled water for 10 minutes (2 times).

steps.title: Dehydrate Cells
steps.instruction: Dehydrate cells by immersing the material in graduated solutions of acetone.

substeps.instruction: Immerse in acetone 15%, 30%, and 50% for 10 minutes each.
Immerse in acetone 70% in uranyl acetate 1% for 30 minutes.
Immerse in acetone 100% in copper sulfate 2 times for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Infiltrate Cells
steps.instruction: Infiltrate cells by immersing the material in epoxy resin and acetone P.A.

substeps.instruction: Immerse in epoxy resin at a 1:3 ratio of acetone P.A. for 30 minutes.
Immerse in epoxy resin at a 3:1 ratio of acetone P.A. overnight.

steps.title: Embed and Polymerize Cells
steps.instruction: Embed cells by adding epoxy resin to the eppendorfs containing the cells.
